name: University of Sunderland

settingEvidence.evidence: We offer a great choice of accommodation within a short distance of our two campuses and the city centre.

fees.text: £10,050 for the first year for Home (UK) fee-paying students starting in 2027/28. Sunderland says fees are set by Government rules and may increase every year based on the Retail Price Index.

source.evidence: If you're a Home fee-paying student, the fee for your first year of study for 2027/28 will be £10,050.

livingCosts.text: University halls (self-catered) cost about £90-£155 a week for a single student room (Panns Bank £90-£155, Scotia Quay £131-£150, The Precinct £107); family houses cost £187-£215. Rent includes gas, electricity, water, internet and contents insurance; 40-week or 50-week contracts (for example £3,600-£4,500 for the cheapest Panns Bank room). The pages do not say which academic year the prices are for.

contextual.summary: Home-fee applicants who meet at least one of Sunderland's contextual statements can get an offer lowered by 8 UCAS tariff points, or by up to 16 points if two or more statements apply.
contextual.typicalReduction: Up to 16 UCAS tariff points: 8 points if one statement applies to you, 16 points if two or more apply.

criteria.detail: You live in one of these postcode areas: DH, DL, NE, SR, TS, CA1, CA14, HU5, HU8, LA9, LS3, OL12, PR1, PR25, SK2, WA4, WF8, YO12, YO23
You live in a neighbourhood of low participation in higher education: postcode in POLAR quintiles 1 and 2 (the page does not give a POLAR version number)
Postcodes in TUNDRA quintiles 1 and 2 are also accepted
You are the first generation in your immediate family to attend university
You are care-experienced (listed together with being irreconcilably estranged from your family)
You are irreconcilably estranged from your family (listed together with being care-experienced)
You are an asylum seeker or refugee
You receive free school meals or were eligible within the last six years (not part of the UCAS form: email evidence to admissions@sunderland.ac.uk)
You are part of the Gypsy, Traveller, Roma, Showmen or Boater communities (email evidence to admissions@sunderland.ac.uk)
You are a student from a UK armed forces family (military service child) (email evidence to admissions@sunderland.ac.uk)

contextual.rulesText: To be eligible for an 8 UCAS tariff point reduction, one of the listed statements must apply to you; for a 16 point reduction, two or more must apply. You must be a Home fee-status student paying full tuition fees and a first-year applicant to a full-time course of at least three years. Contextual offers cannot be used against Foundation degrees or Integrated Foundation Years. The maximum is 16 tariff points and tariff point adjustments cannot be used in conjunction with each other.

source.evidence: To be eligible for an 8 UCAS tariff point reduction, one of the following statements must apply to you.

programmes.name: First Choice Progression Scheme (with Summer School)
programmes.summary: Year 12 progression scheme with a skills session and a compulsory on-campus Summer School; completing it earns 16 tariff points off your offer, a guaranteed conditional offer and a guaranteed interview at Sunderland.
programmes.whoCanApply: Year 12 students at a school or college that is part of the First Choice Scheme, who want to go on to higher education, are interested in a course or subject Sunderland offers and are expected to achieve at least 96 UCAS points from their Level 3 qualifications.
programmes.eligibilityDetail: No widening participation criteria are listed for the main scheme (the separate First Choice: Medicine strand has them). Students must register their interest, complete a skills session in Year 12 (at school or college, on campus or online) and their school or college must be part of the scheme.
benefits: 16 tariff points to complement your offer (courses starting September 2027, either Sunderland campus; not MBChB Medicine)
A guaranteed conditional offer (not for courses that need an interview) and a guaranteed interview
Dedicated First Choice scholarships and awards
Experience of university life at the Summer School, plus support through the application process
You must complete all parts of the scheme and make Sunderland your firm choice on UCAS before the May 2027 deadline to get the tariff points and guaranteed offer/interview
programmes.subjects: All subjects (subject-specific workshops at the Summer School)

offer.text: Typical offer 96-112 UCAS Tariff points from a combination of acceptable Level 3 qualifications (A levels, T Levels, BTEC Diplomas/Extended Diplomas, Scottish and Irish Highers, Access to HE Diplomas or the International Baccalaureate); at most 6 points from Level 3 Key Skills. No A level grades are published.

gcse.note: Three GCSE passes at grade C/4 or above including maths and English language (or Level 2 Key Skills in Application of Number)

gcse.subject: English Language
gcse.note: Three GCSE passes at grade C/4 or above including maths and English language (or Level 2 Key Skills in Communication)
